about_the_game:
This DLC is still in development. Estimated date: 2026. Purchasing is unavailable—please add it to your wishlist.
Episode 3 is a direct continuation of Episode 2.

After the events of the previous chapter, the tension keeps rising.
Can Lida handle new emotional challenges and stay strong?
What secrets will be revealed, and where will your choices lead?

In this episode, you’ll see how the story unfolds further.
Your decisions will once again shape the main character’s path.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains minimal textual descriptions of intimate relationships without detailed scenes. It includes occasional strong language and mentions teenage pregnancy, including discussions about the possibility of abortion.

short_description: After the events of Episode 2, the tension only grows stronger. Will Lida be able to endure new hardships and cope with her own emotions? What secrets will come to light, and where will the new choices lead? Your decisions will once again shape the course of the story.
